messages:
Riley: Quick flag - latency spike during the demo, looks like the CDN edge for eu-west is lagging. Viewer reports in chat.
Ana: Seeing the same in monitoring - p95 jumped to 7s for a 20s window. Switching to fallback edge cluster now.
Marcus: Heads up hosts: we should pause live Qs for ~45s while we failover, otherwise audience questions will be out of order.
Riley: Command I'm running in case anyone wants to mirror:
```
# failover to fallback edge
cdnctl route --from=eu-west --to=eu-fallback --drain=20s
```
Ana: Failover initiated. Draining sessions, will cut over in ~30s.
stream-bot: [automated] CDN failover started: from=eu-west to=eu-fallback, expected_cutover=30s
Marcus: Hosts asked to hold audience mics. I'll update the op note and the on-screen banner to say "Hold questions - brief technical pause".
Olivia (CEO): Fine to pause. Also: we had pre-submitted roadmap Qs - let's reserve 3 of them for the end and handle audience ones after that.
Riley: Noted. I'll reorder the Q&A queue: pre-submitted -> leadership -> audience. David (ops) will get the final cue.
edits-bot: [automated] Recorder split: /recordings/allhands/segment_before_failover.mp4 and /recordings/allhands/segment_after_failover.mp4
Ana: Cutover complete, viewer latency back to normal (p95 1.8s). Resuming captions and Q&A flow.
stream-bot: [automated] Stream health OK: viewers=1.4k, dropped_frames=0.0%
Marcus: Hosts - please resume. Riley, please pass the cue when ready to call Olivia up for her prefaced roadmap answer.
Riley: Calling Olivia in 20s. Will give a 10s heads-up on the countdown.
Olivia (CEO): Thanks team. After my roadmap answer, let's keep 10 minutes for live questions and one backup for follow-ups.
Riley: Roger that. Posting postmortem note to #all-hands with timestamps and recording links once we wrap.
Ana: I'll also drop the CDN incident id and the metrics snapshot for SRE.
Riley: Thanks all. Back to program :rocket:
